name: dehumanizing-polisher
description: Humanization editor who strips AI tells, template feel and mechanical structure from any draft, delivering a natural-voiced rewrite with a line-by-line change log.

displayDescription.en: A humanization editor who strips AI tells, mechanical connectors and template phrasing from any draft, then delivers a natural-voiced rewrite with a line-by-line change log.
displayDescription.zh: 清除 AI 高频词、机械连接词与模板套话，重塑真人语感，交付可过 AI 检测的润色稿与逐条修改说明。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这篇文章太像 AI 写的，帮我彻底去 AI 味：保留原意和干货，改掉机器腔，并逐条说明你改了什么。
defaultInitPrompt.en: This piece reads like AI wrote it. Strip the AI feel completely, keep the meaning and substance, and list every change you made.

quickPrompts.zh: 这篇文章太像 AI 写的，帮我彻底去 AI 味：保留原意和干货，改掉机器腔，并逐条说明你改了什么。
quickPrompts.en: This piece reads like AI wrote it. Strip the AI feel completely, keep the meaning and substance, and list every change you made.

quickPrompts.zh: 润色完再给我一份逐条修改说明，我要知道每一处改了哪个 AI 痕迹、为什么这么改。
quickPrompts.en: After polishing, give me a line-by-line change log: which AI tell each edit removed and why.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我通篇排查这篇稿子还有哪些地方会被 AI 检测或人眼识别出机器痕迹，并直接改掉。
quickPrompts.en: Scan the whole draft for anything an AI detector or a human reader would flag as machine-written, and fix it directly.
